message: 炎の魔球

name: Sally
message: 「All riiight, gather 'round, everyoone!」
Everyone has transformed and is ready to go.

name: Sally
message: 「Ahem. I'm Sally, and I'll be in charge of the Student Council's special training today!」

name: Sally
message: 「The idol of the Demon World is gonna strip down and lend a hand! Mmm-hmm~\s04」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If you strip, your idol career ends right then and there.」

name: Sally
message: 「Ms. Lolotte...」

name: Sally
message: 「--Wait, I'm the teacher today! Helena told me to whip you guys into shape, so you'd better brace yourselves!」

name: Ria
message: 「Sally is a full-fledged demon, after all. She's the most reliable person to help us come up with countermeasures.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「To be taught by a mere bonus character... How the Crusaders have fallen.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're part of that group too, you know.」

name: Misa
message: 「So, Sally, what kind of special training will you be putting us through?」

name: Sally
message: 「Heh-heh-heh, I'm glad you asked! Believe it or not, I've brought out my prized--」

name: Sally
message: 「Demon World Mail-Order goods~~♪」
Things suddenly took a turn for the worse.

name: Sally
message: 「This Infernal Pitching Machine right here is gonna launch some crazy stuff straight at you guys!」

name: Sally
message: 「You'll smack whatever comes out right back with your weapons. You could call it a reverse thousand-fungo drill?」

name: Synn
message: 「Isn't that just normal batting practice...」

name: Sally
message: 「Shut up! Anyway, let's do a little practice run!」
A razor-sharp projectile that could easily send me straight to the afterlife grazes past my cheek and vanishes into the distant sky.
And what's more, something smells burnt.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Did that thing just hop mid-air?」

name: Sally
message: 「Believe it or not, it's gyro-powered!」

name: Ria
message: 「'Why don't you ask Gyro, gyro?'」

name: Misa
message: 「What is the point of it being gyro-powered?!」

name: Sally
message: 「Don't ask me to explain the joke!」

name: Ria
message: 「I don't think that's the part she was calling out.\s02」

name: Sally
message: 「Anyway, you guys are way too dense. Especially you, Prez!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh. Me?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah~」

name: Ria
message: 「Now that you mention it.」

name: Misa
message: 「Indeed.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I feel like I understand.」

name: Synn
message: 「I really don't think that's true, though.」

name: Ria
message: 「Hehe. That's exactly why everyone calls you insensitive.」

name: Synn
message: 「I think my skin is actually on the sensitive side, though...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Damn you for having such smooth skin even though you're a dude!」

name: Misa
message: 「It's truuuly unforgivable!\s09」

name: Lolotte
message: 「At this rate, it looks like this will turn into special training to toughen up the President's mind.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll pass hard on that.」

name: Sally
message: 「Alright. Then, here comes another one!」

name: Paqy
message: 「What's this, what's this? Sounds like you're having fun!」
Ah, Paqy. How many times do I have to tell you not to come out at a time like this--.

name: Paqy
message: 「HAWBUAAAH!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hot, hot, ouch-ouch-ouch-ouch!」
Paqy bursts into flames and writhes around on the ground.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Isn't this thing you're throwing just a ball of fire?!」

name: Sally
message: 「No, no. It's a Fireball.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「THAT'S THE SAME THING!」

name: Sally
message: 「It's a special magic pitch packed full of mana and heartfelt sincerity.」

name: Misa
message: 「All we have to do is hit it back, right? That's simple. First, I'll--」

name: Misa
message: 「Ugh.」
Misa goes down without a fight.

name: Sally
message: 「By the way, there's no telling where they'll fly, so be careful.\s07」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Say that sooner!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So exciting... Spartan training, huh. Lolotte, heading ouuuut.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Gah.」
And you can guess the rest.

name: Ria
message: 「Hey, could this actually be...」
Ria-senpai conjures something like a shield out of Spirit Power.
Then she endures the impact of the incoming fireball and knocks it down.

name: Ria
message: 「Maybe we're supposed to block them instead of hitting them back?」

name: Sally
message: 「Yeah, you could put it that way.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So that's it. Sounds like even I can pull that off.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Kah!」
Life was never that easy.

name: Synn
message: 「Some special training... It's way harder than anything we've done so far...」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah. We really have to stay sharp for this.」

name: Synn
message: 「All right! I'm going to dare to hit it back instead!」

name: Sally
message: 「Heh heh heh. Don't come crying to me later.」
The pitcher winds up and throws the first pitch.

name: Synn
message: 「Take thiiis.」
Not quite a home run, but a line drive straight back at the pitcher!

name: Sally
message: 「Wha! Wha-wha-whaaa--!」
A direct hit on the Demon World Mail-Order gadget. Only for it to start spewing smoke--

name: Synn
message: 「Th-this is bad.」

name: Everyone
message: 「Kyaaaah!」
Thanks to that, our fear of fire eased up just a little.
Or at least it felt like it did.
